rows.prompt: Summarise this paragraph in one sentence: The supplier shall deliver the goods within 30 days of the purchase order. If delivery is late, the buyer may cancel the order and receive a full refund.
rows.base: The supplier must deliver goods within 30 days of receiving the purchase order, or the buyer can cancel the order and receive a full refund if delivery is delayed.
rows.finetuned: The supplier must deliver goods within 30 days of receiving the purchase order, or the buyer can cancel the order and receive a full refund if delivery is delayed.

Write a short polite email asking a colleague to review my report by Friday.
rows.base:
Subject: Request for Review of Report

Dear [Colleague's Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to request your review of my recent report on [briefly describe the report's purpose or content]. I would greatly appreciate your feedback as it will be invaluable for our upcoming project.

Please review the report by Friday, [insert date], and let me know your thoughts. Your insights will be crucial in helping us make informed decisions.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
rows.finetuned:
Subject: Request for Review of Report

Dear [Colleague's Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to request your review of my recent report on [briefly describe the report's purpose or content]. As we are approaching the deadline of Friday, I would greatly appreciate your availability to review it.

Please let me know if you are able to review the report by Friday. If not, I would be grateful for your availability to review it on another date.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

rows.prompt: Explain what a non-disclosure agreement is to a 10-year-old, in 2 sentences.
rows.base: A non-disclosure agreement is like a promise to keep something secret. It's when grown-ups agree not to tell others about something important, so they can't use it without permission. It's like a special rule to protect something that belongs to someone else.
rows.finetuned: A non-disclosure agreement is like a promise to keep something secret. It's when grown-ups agree not to tell others about something they've shared, just like you wouldn't tell your friend what's in your lunchbox.
